class IncludeTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self._tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.dir = self._tmp.name

    def tearDown(self):
        self._tmp.cleanup()

    def write(self, name, text):
        path = os.path.join(self.dir, name)
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
        with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            fh.write(text)
        return path

    def test_inline_and_override_order(self):
        self.write("inc.conf", "a = 1\nb = 2\n")
        main = self.write("main.conf", "a = 0\n@include inc.conf\nb = 9\n")
        cfg = load(main)
        self.assertEqual(cfg.get("a"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(cfg.get("b"), 9)

    def test_relative_to_including_file_and_nested(self):
        self.write("sub/leaf.conf", "leaf = yes\n")
        self.write("sub/mid.conf", "@include leaf.conf\nmid = 1\n")
        main = self.write("main.conf", "@include sub/mid.conf\n")
        cfg = load(main)
        self.assertEqual(cfg.get("mid"), 1)
        self.assertTrue(cfg.get("leaf"))

    def test_missing(self):
        main = self.write("main.conf", "@include nope.conf\n")
        with self.assertRaises(ConfigError):
            load(main)

    def test_cycles(self):
        self.write("a.conf", "@include b.conf\n")
        self.write("b.conf", "@include a.conf\n")
        with self.assertRaises(ConfigError):
            load(os.path.join(self.dir, "a.conf"))
        selfref = self.write("s.conf", "@include s.conf\n")
        with self.assertRaises(ConfigError):
            load(selfref)

    def test_same_file_included_twice_is_not_cycle(self):
        self.write("x.conf", "x = 1\n")
        main = self.write("main.conf", "@include x.conf\n@include x.conf\n")
        self.assertEqual(load(main).get("x"), 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
